topic: Balance transfers advertised at zero-percent APR almost always carry a 3 to 5 percent upfront fee people forget to count
title: Balance Transfer Trap: The Hidden 3-5% Upfront Fee
description:
Zero percent APR balance transfers sound great. But the fine print hides an upfront fee that can cost you hundreds before you even start saving. Don't fall for the hidden costs.

#BalanceTransfer #CreditCardFees #HiddenFees #PersonalFinance #AntiBroke
